text: 科创50指数半日涨4.5%，创业板指涨超2%，算力硬件、半导体板块集体走强。 恒指半日涨0.12%，恒生科技指数涨0.87%，智谱大涨逾8%，华虹宏力、联想涨逾7%。 香港发布首个五年规划：聚焦人工智能产业，强化全球最大离岸人民币枢纽功能。 中国央行行长潘功胜：不能简单以信贷增速衡量金融支持实体经济的力度。 中国平陆运河正式建成通航，可通航5000吨级船舶。
text_en: The STAR 50 Index rose 4.5% in the half-day session, the ChiNext Index rose over 2%, and computing power hardware and semiconductor sectors strengthened collectively. The Hang Seng Index rose 0.12% in the half-day session, the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 0.87%, Zhipu surged over 8%, and Hua Hong Semiconductor and Lenovo rose over 7%. Hong Kong releases its first five-year plan: focusing on the artificial intelligence industry and strengthening its function as the world's largest offshore RMB hub. PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng: Credit growth alone cannot be simply used to measure the strength of financial support for the real economy. China's Pinglu Canal is officially completed and open to navigation, capable of accommodating 5,000-tonne vessels.
